policies.title: Sammarinese ordinary passports: Angola electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: San Marino's current destination guidance says Sammarinese visitors must obtain Angola's electronic visa before departure.
conditions: The traveller must carry the printed electronic-visa confirmation; passport, return travel, funds and invitation or accommodation evidence remain required.
Work, residence, diplomatic, official and special-document treatment are outside this ordinary short-visitor baseline.

policies.title: Sammarinese ordinary passports: Côte d’Ivoire visa on arrival after approved pre-enrolment
policies.summary: San Marino's current guidance says the biometric Côte d’Ivoire visitor visa is issued on arrival at Abidjan after approved pre-enrolment and registration receipt.
conditions: Before departure, obtain and print the approved pre-enrolment and registration receipt; the visa is issued at Abidjan airport.
An embassy route is separately available. Passport, yellow-fever, return-travel, funds and final-admission requirements remain applicable.

policies.title: Sammarinese ordinary passports: Jordan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board nationality table states that San Marino visitors can obtain a paid visa on arrival.
conditions: Jordan's current visitor guidance requires non-Jordanian travellers to obtain a Gateway2Jordan QR code before departure.
Passport validity, purpose, permitted ports, security screening and final admission remain applicable; work, residence and special documents are outside scope.

policies.title: Sammarinese ordinary passports: North Macedonia visa exemption
policies.summary: San Marino's current Foreign Affairs guidance says Sammarinese visitors do not need a visa for up to 90 days in 180 days in North Macedonia.
conditions: Carry a passport valid at least 90 days from arrival, return or onward travel and accommodation confirmation.
Work, residence, diplomatic, official and special-document treatment are outside this ordinary short-visitor baseline.

policies.title: Sammarinese ordinary passports: Mali advance visitor visa
policies.summary: San Marino's current Foreign Affairs guidance directs Sammarinese visitors to obtain a Mali visa from the Embassy in Rome before travel.
conditions: The current guidance specifies the Embassy of Mali in Rome; return or onward travel, funds, passport and final admission remain required.
Work, residence, diplomatic, official and special-document treatment are outside this ordinary short-visitor baseline.
